summary: The exact candidate fixes the reported backend-none DP reduce-scatterv arithmetic, but incorrectly scales the TP1 shared expert for all post-expert all-reduce skip reasons. A2A backends whose combine already returns reduced routed output have no later SUM for the separate shared output, so the candidate changes correct R + S output to R + S/moe_ep_size.

tests.what_was_measured: On gfx950, the prepared base matched R + 8*S within 1.4603137969970703e-06 and differed from R + S by 15.595806956291199.
All five candidate helper-level regression and boundary tests passed.
On gfx950, the reported downstream-SUM invariant matched R + S within 6.92903995513916e-07.
Independent A2A no-later-SUM boundary failed: candidate produced R + S/8 instead of R + S, with maximum absolute error 7.0.

gpu_execution.evidence: Arithmetic checks ran on one AMD Instinct MI355X with gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015.

remaining_counterexamples: With a TP1 shared expert and a skip caused by an A2A backend whose combine already reduces routed expert output and has no later SUM for shared_output, EP=8 produces R + S/8 instead of R + S.
remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned, so actual eight-rank RCCL reduce-scatterv and A2A transport were not executed.
DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat and GLM-5.2 weights were unavailable; no full-model serving or semantic-accuracy claim is made.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
